sql.select: SELECT photo_variant_id, layer_type, position_x, position_y, rotation_degrees, scale_x, scale_y, sorting_order FROM photo_layer_layouts ORDER BY photo_variant_id, sorting_order, layer_type;

SELECT photo_variant_id, layer_type, position_x, position_y, rotation_degrees, scale_x, scale_y, sorting_order FROM photo_layer_layouts WHERE photo_variant_id = @photo_variant_id ORDER BY sorting_order, layer_type;
sql.delete: DELETE FROM photo_layer_layouts WHERE photo_variant_id = @photo_variant_id AND layer_type = @layer_type;
